struct@(A,B) Pair {
  x:Int@A;
  y:Int@B;
}

func@(A,B) combine(pairA: Pair@(A,_), pairB: Pair@(_,B)) Pair@(A,B) {
return Pair@(A,B) { x: pairA.x, y: pairB.y };
}

func@(A,B) main() {
  let pairA = Pair@(A,_) { x: 10 };
  let pairB = Pair@(_,B) { y: 20 };

  let result = combine@(A,B)(pairA, pairB);
}
---
(source-file
  (struct
    (role-type
      (role A)
      (role B)) Pair
    (struct-body
      (struct-field x
        (named-type Int@
          (role-type
            (role A))))
      (struct-field y
        (named-type Int@
          (role-type
            (role B))))))
  (func
    (func-sig
      (role-type
        (role A)
        (role B)) combine
      (params
        (param pairA
          (named-type Pair@
            (role-type
              (role A)
              (role _))))
        (param pairB
          (named-type Pair@
            (role-type
              (role _)
              (role B)))))
      (named-type Pair@
        (role-type
          (role A)
          (role B))))
    (scope "{"
      (return
        (struct-expr Pair@
          (role-type
            (role A)
            (role B))
          (field-init x
            (field pairA x))
          (field-init y
            (field pairB y)) "}") ";") "}"))
  (func
    (func-sig
      (role-type
        (role A)
        (role B)) main
      (params))
    (scope "{"
      (let pairA
        (struct-expr Pair@
          (role-type
            (role A)
            (role _))
          (field-init x
            (int 10)) "}") ";")
      (let pairB
        (struct-expr Pair@
          (role-type
            (role _)
            (role B))
          (field-init y
            (int 20)) "}") ";")
      (let result
        (call combine@
          (role-type
            (role A)
            (role B)) pairA pairB ")") ";") "}")))
